jsonld_raw.name: ABSOLUTE LINEN CAR AIR FRESHENER
jsonld_raw.description:
Car air freshener with a clip.

Absolute Linen | Very fresh thanks to blackcurrant and subtle hints of tangerine. The woody notes also create a warm atmosphere.
Scent notes: fig leaf, iris, musk.

Instructions for use: Remove the air freshener's wrapper and place it on the dashboard (the ideal spot is the air conditioner mesh) using the back clip. The duration of this product will depend on factors such as temperature or light exposure.
